page.layout: One printed page, full width: ornamental headline at top, title and dedication lines centred, then the first paragraph beginning with a decorated initial. No margin notes, no running head, no page number.

main_text.head: ILLVSTRIS- SIMIS, REVEREN- DISSIMIS, HEROI- cæcq virtutis PPr.ac DDn. Dn. FRIDERICO junior. Comiti Palatino Rheni, Vtriusq; Bavariæ Duci, &c. Nec non Dn. OTTHONI Hassiæ Landgraiuio, &c. Postulato Administratori Hirsfeldensi: DDn. & Mecœnatibus suis clementissimis, hunc de vita bene ac salubriter prorogânda, tractatum, debita observantia, officii, subiectionis ergo, humilima manu offert, dedicat, consecrat, Rodolphus Goclenius Med. D.

page.notes: The initial S is a large woodcut letter joined to "Anitatem", read as SANITATEM. Several words in the italic dedication are set in mixed type and some letters are uncertain, e.g. "prorogânda" and "cæcq", which are transcribed as printed; the last line "mum" is a continuation of "maximum" split across the page.
